selection.summary: Diagnosed and patched the two NodeBB v4.4.3 dropdown bugs using base evidence. (1) Notifications race/glitches: h5 shows forum/header/notifications.js loads notifications via requireAndCall on 'show.bs.dropdown' and also in a .each pre-open pass; h18/h3/h31 show Notifications.loadNotifications fires async socket 'notifications.get' and only renders after hooks + parseAndTranslate, so overlapping loads can render stale data out of order and toggle handlers rebind mid-flight. Patch: serialize concurrent loads with a loadingNotifList promise guard, wrapping notifications.get in a Promise and nulling the guard before handling err/data. (2) Category selector dropup in fork/move modals: h0/h19 show fork-topic.tpl imports selector-dropdown-right.tpl; h7/h6 show the selector root has no dropup class handling, h4/h20 show categorySearch.js only handles show/hide visibility and search, with bsDropdown.update() in renderList but no viewport-based dropup logic, while h15/h16 show postTools/threadTools use the top > window.innerHeight/2 dropup heuristic. Patch: on 'show.bs.dropdown' in categorySearch.init, toggle 'dropup' based on the toggle's viewport position and clear menu-start/menu-end alignment so menus in modals render in the right place. h2 confirms fork.js initializes the selector via categorySelector.init on the parsed modal (h12/h21), so the patched path covers fork/move modals.
